title: KPDCL Announces Power Shutdowns in Several Areas - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: The Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has announced scheduled power shutdowns across several areas of Srinagar and Budgam districts on November 28, 29, December 1 and 3 due to maintenance work on transmission lines and a grid station.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, power supply to several areas will remain affected between 9 am and 3 pm or 10 am and 3 pm, depending on the scheduled shutdown.
On November 28, power supply to Children’s Hospital, State Motor Garage, Hajj House, Usmania Colony, Directorate of Health Services and adjoining areas will be affected from 10 am to 3 pm due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Narbal Tap at Toyota Ansari and Children’s Hospital Tap of JVC-PC Depot, along with the 11 kV F2 and F3 feeders of Receiving Station Bemina-III/JVC.
On the same day, power supply to BK Pora, Chattergam, Kenihama, Aribagh, Checkpora and adjoining areas will remain affected from 9 am to 3 pm due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Pampore-BK Pora line.
On November 29, areas including Ompora, SIDCO, Housing Colony, Budgam Railway Station, NIFT and adjoining localities will face a power shutdown from 10 am to 3 pm due to maintenance work on the 33 kV Budgam-SIDCO line.
Similarly, on December 1, power supply to Wuyen, Balhama, Munpora, Befina, Zafran Colony, Khonmoh, Checksangri, JKAP, TCI Old Cement Plant and the Industrial Area will remain affected from 9 am to 3 pm due to the shutdown of the 132/33 kV, 100 MVA Grid Station Khunmoh.
On December 3, the shutdown of the 33 kV Bemina-JVC line will affect power supply to JVC Hospital, Children’s Hospital, State Motor Garage, Hajj House, Forensic Lab, PC Depot, Qamarwari, Barthana and adjoining areas from 10 am to 3 pm.
